scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and proceeded to checkout.
Entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon, then placed the order.
The order was confirmed as TS-7788, with €17.90 charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag as requested.
Opened the bag and confirmed shipping was €4.90 with a €49.40 total.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once; shipping updated to Free and the total updated to €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag, entered the lowercase promo code welcome10, and applied it.
The promo was applied successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.

fix.summary: The promo code was looked up without uppercasing, so lowercase codes like welcome10 were rejected; the cart now trims and uppercases the entered code before the lookup in src/pages/Cart.tsx.
